sources.citation: Dhakal, Dubi Nanda. 2019. Verb agreement in Darai and Majhi in areal-typological context. Slides, University of Helsinki, 27-29 April 2019.
Dhakal, Dubi Nanda. 2017. Exploring the parameters of verb agreement in Majhi. Gipan 3(2): 5-25. DOI 10.3126/gipan.v3i2.48896.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Nothing on stress; morphosyntax only. Reference list names Dhakal 2013 (NL 28) and Dhakal 2014 grammar as the only Majhi descriptions.

sources.citation: Chalise, Krishna Prasad. 2014. A sociolinguistic survey of the Majhi language. Report submitted to Linguistic Survey of Nepal (LinSuN), Central Department of Linguistics, Tribhuvan University. 122 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; chapters are dialect mapping, domains of use, multilingualism, vitality (Ramechhap survey). Hosted by the Language Commission of Nepal.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1/5.3 languoid page majh1253 and reference records 311588, 323731; Wikipedia 'Majhi language' (phonology section sourced to Dhakal 2014); Language Commission of Nepal page 'माझी' (content/10038).
sources.note: Glottolog lists only Dhakal 2008/2014/2017; Wikipedia's phonology section (vowels, consonants, syllable structure) says nothing about stress; the Language Commission page only links the Chalise 2014 survey.

sources.citation: Dhakal, Dubi Nanda. 2013. Verb agreement in Majhi. Nepalese Linguistics 28: 31-37.
sources.note: Nothing on stress; footnote 1 says the data are 'mainly from Tamakoshi dialect of Majhi'.

sources.citation: Dhakal, Dubi Nanda. 2012. Preliminary notes on Majhi case. Nepalese Linguistics 27: 30-; and Dhakal 2011, Pronominal possessive affixes in Darai, Majhi and Kusunda, Nepalese Linguistics 26 (whole volumes 22-27, 29-34 scanned).
sources.note: No stress rule; vol 27 only uses 'independent phonological accent with longer syllable structure' as a criterion separating postpositions from case affixes. Full-text grep of NL vols 23-27, 29-34 plus the site TOC finds no Majhi phonology paper (vol 22 is an image-only scan, TOC lists no Majhi paper).

sources.citation: Niraula, Krishna Prasad. 2011. Majhi bhasa ra Nepali bhasaka padasangatiko tulanatmak adhyayan [Comparative study of agreement in Majhi and Nepali]. M.Ed. thesis, Tribhuvan University. hdl:20.500.14540/7509.
sources.note: Agreement thesis in legacy-font Nepali; no phonology/stress section found.
